_comment: Accepted axe findings for scripts/a11y-cls-gate.mjs, id "<route>:<rule>" (or "*:<rule>"). Each entry needs a reason; remove it once fixed.

accepted.reason: Known phone-width overlap, found when this gate was added: at 390x800 the fixed bottom sales bar (SalesCTA.tsx, email link) is partly covered by another fixed bar's two buttons, so axe measures a 17px-tall target. Real bug, tracked for a UI fix; accepted so the gate can block new regressions.
